request.prompt: Instrumental thirty-second victory results cue for an anime shipgirl naval game. Open immediately with a genuinely joyful short rising French horn melody, buoyant rhythmic phrasing and a bright clear major resolution, gently supported by viola chords and one restrained timpani accent. Explicit earned victory and happy companions, not just cozy contentment. This four-to-six-second celebration happens once. Then gradually settle into a tender clarinet and piano homecoming phrase, quieter and slower in gesture, with a complete gentle peaceful ending. Simple memorable melody, one lead at a time, transparent small ensemble and well-shaped emotional descent from celebration to calm. No repeated fanfare, busy countermelodies, dense drums or sudden loudness spikes. Music only, entirely instrumental: no voices, choir, speech, ocean ambience or weapon sounds. Clear melodic lead and quiet supporting parts, natural acoustic tone, comfortable midrange, restrained dynamics and coherent connected phrases.
